Bill.BriefDescription: Placing restrictions and obligations on agency personal service contracts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to agency personal service contracts; and amendingRCW 39.29.008.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 39.29.008 and 1993 c 433 s 6 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Personal services may be procured only to resolve a particularagency problem or issue or to expedite a specific project that istemporary in nature. An agency may procure personal services only if: (1) It documents that: (((1))) (a) The service is critical to agency responsibilities oroperations, or is mandated or authorized by the legislature; (((2))) (b) Sufficient staffing or expertise is not availablewithin the agency to perform the service; ((and (3))) (c) Other qualified public resources are not available toperform the service; and (d) Procedures are in place to monitor, audit, and enforce theterms of the contract and the agency can report on the status andresults of the contract upon request. p. 1 HB 3055 (2)(a) An agency must establish a contract review committee toensure compliance with the requirements under subsection (1) of thissection and RCW 39.29.100 and 41.06.142 to assist in preparing theproposal or personal service contract. The committee must haverepresentation from all staffing levels. (b) An agency must notify the contract review committee, exclusivebargaining unit representative, and the appropriate committees of thelegislature about: (i) Who the contractors are; (ii) The work the contractors are doing; (iii) Where the work will be performed and whether any work will bedone outofstate or offshore; (iv) Any problems that may have occurred under prior contractsincluding, but not limited to, breach of contract, cost overruns,failure to perform in a timely manner, or failure to complete; and (v) Other contracts the contractors have, or had, with the agencyor other agencies of state government. (c) An agency, through the contract review committee, shallestablish and include in any proposal for purchase of personal servicesand subsequent contract written criteria regarding those terms of thecontract for which a breach in performance requires the cancellation ofthe contract and the procurement of a new contract under subsection (1)of this section.
